Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry) workflow using DDA and spectral counting for quantification. While the biological study discusses acetylation and ubiquitylation, the proteomics runs described in the PRIDE metadata and methods are for interactome mapping (AP-MS) and not for PTM-enrichment (e.g., no TiO2 or K-GG antibodies used for the MS runs).

scope: The interactomes of BRD proteins were obtained by analyzing affinity purification of BRD proteins coupled with mass spectrometry (AP-MS)
We performed tandem affinity purification (TAP) with the 24 HR promoting BRD proteins identified in our DSB repair screen.

inducible SFB-tagged BRD proteins expressed in HEK-293 cells were treated with tetracycline (1 μg/ml) for 24 h. Cells were lysed with NETN buffer... incubated with 300 μL of streptavidin beads (GE Healthcare) overnight at 4°C... eluted samples were incubated for 4 h with 40 μL of S-protein beads (Novagen) at 4°C... Samples were eluted by boiling with 2× Laemmli buffer and resolved by SDS-PAGE for mass spectrometry analysis.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzed material obtained via tandem affinity purification (TAP) of SFB-tagged BRD proteins. While the text mentions 'chromatin fractionation' and 'whole cell extract' (as a control), the primary MS analysis for the interactome was performed on affinity-purified complexes.
